title: Improved focus and wellbeing
body: This app really helps me plan my day and focus on one task at a time, contributing to improving my mental health. I really like the fact that after you add your tasks, you can see the time of the day you’d be done with all of them. Also, the chimes help me stay on task, while the overtime helps me to learn about my time estimations. ADHDers look no further - and I’m sure it’s a great tool for anyone really. I can see there’s a lot of knowledge and passion that go into making this app. Thank you Llamalife team, you rock!
author: lookingattheblueskies
